hero.description: An African energy group, ZENER develops fuel, gas, mobility and service solutions to sustainably support individuals, businesses and institutions.

presentation.badge: An African energy group on the move
presentation.text: ZENER develops and deploys energy solutions tailored to the realities of African markets. Through its activities in fuel, gas, lubricants, mobility and energy services, the Group supports individuals, professionals, businesses and institutions every day. Present in Benin, Togo and Guinea-Bissau, ZENER continues its regional growth, drawing on an in-depth understanding of its markets, dedicated infrastructure and a culture of usage-driven innovation.

expertise.subtitle: Leading brands and innovative solutions serving energy and mobility.
expertise.label: Our business lines

fuel.title: Fuel Distribution
fuel.text: From supply to distribution, ZENER deploys its expertise through its storage infrastructure and network of service stations, with constant attention to quality, safety and product availability.

gas.title: Gas & Energy Solutions
gas.text: From household use to industrial applications, ZENER deploys its gas expertise and develops energy solutions tailored to new challenges, notably through Gas-to-Power.

mobility.title: Mobility & Services
mobility.text: Through an ecosystem of digital services and mobility solutions, ZENER simplifies access to energy, streamlines usage and enhances the customer experience. These solutions extend our core businesses and pave the way for new energy and mobility uses.

lubricants.title: Lubricants & Specialty Products
lubricants.text: ZENER complements its energy offering with a range of lubricants and accessories designed to combine performance, reliability and quality of use.

business.title: Solutions for Businesses & Institutions
business.text: ZENER puts all of its expertise at the service of businesses and institutions, through solutions tailored to their energy, operational and business continuity needs.

banner.title: ZENER Benin, by your side
banner.text: Based in Cotonou, we guarantee constant proximity and availability of our products and services, with the ambition to grow our network across the country.

quality.title: Quality
quality.text: We guarantee products and services that meet the industry's most demanding standards.

security.title: Safety
security.text: Protecting our customers, employees and infrastructure remains our top priority.

responsibility.title: Responsibility
responsibility.text: We promote sustainable development through responsible, environmentally-conscious actions.
